rule: Inputs of the mechanical and fatigue screens, one row per candidate condition, written before any result. Each value is published (source id of docs/research/935-loads-alloys-20261122.md, re-read in the saved copy on 2026-11-22 unless marked) or a hypothesis with its register id. Data quality: Q1 = the same alloy and condition, LPBF, at that temperature; Q2 = the same alloy, LPBF, another or an unstated condition. A strength is read by straight lines between published temperatures and never extrapolated. Nothing here is a design allowable: datasheet and coupon values, most of one orientation, short soaks, small samples.
orientation_note: where a source gives orientations, the vertical (build direction) value is taken for room temperature, and the only published orientation above it; Lehmhus 2022 gives the 0 degree (upright) bars

candidates.field_note: the lowest conductivity of stress-relieved AlSi10Mg in params/alloy-candidates.json (EOS 270 degC 90 min; 3D Systems about 285 degC 2 h): not the same stress relief as the strengths

modulus_GPa.source: lehmhus2022, Table A2, 0 degree, as-built surface, room temperature

expansion_per_K.source: yang2018_jmr: 'CTE value between room temperature and 350 degC is 23.5 ppm/degC' (as built, after the first heating cycle)

yield_MPa.source: lehmhus2022, Table A2, 0 degree, as-built surface; 2 to 5 samples per row; soak at temperature about 20 min (agent note, not re-read)

fatigue_amplitude_MPa.source: diegidio_thesis2023 (T5, 160 degC 4 h: fully reversed rotating bending, polished, 2e6 cycles, 50 % survival; 20 and 200 degC, the lower of T5 and T6R); bahl2026 abstract (350 degC, 1e7 cycles run-out, 20 Hz, heat treatment and stress ratio not stated)
